messages:
ravi: FYI ran a focused locale smoke on zenon-q4 (int8) and hit a reproducible tokenization/regression when inputs contain ZWSP between CJK and Arabic clusters. affects zh/ja->en and ar->en paths. sample below.
mei: can you paste the raw input + tokenizer output?
ravi: pasted: 
```
INPUT: "今日​العالم。"  // CJK + ZWSP + Arabic + ideographic full stop
TOKENIZER OUT: ["今", "日", "​", "ا", "ل", "ع", "ا", "ل", "م", "。"]
EXPECTED TOKENS: ["今日", "​", "العالم", "。"]
OBS: ZWSP being emitted as its own token and Arabic cluster split across codepoints; in beam outputs punctuation sometimes drops.
BLEU DIFF (fp16 -> int8): -1.34 on locale-zwsp-raft testset
```
eval-bot: automated_run id=run-5512, model=zenon-q4-int8, dataset=locale-zwsp-raft, metrics={bleu:-1.34, chrF:-0.18}, anomalies={zwsp-isolated:27, mixedscript-splits:19} (dashboard: https://ci.redwood/zwsp/5512)

dmitri: interesting. last week we changed embedding remap to use compact-vocab packing for int8 (per-channel quant + asymmetric zp). small zero-point shifts can cause token id collisions which amplify when tokenizer fragments a cluster.
mei: quick experiment: pre-token normalize to remove ZWSP (U+200B) -> zwsp-isolated drops to 2 and BLEU delta halves (-0.62). but removing ZWSP may change semantic spacing for languages that rely on it. need safer approach.
ravi: agreed. two-track plan: 1) short-term preproc transform that preserves ZWSP adjacency semantics (join CJK+ZWSP+Arabic as single cluster) 2) long-term fix in embedding pack to keep token-id alignment stable across quant variants.
dmitri: i'll bisect quant-pack commits to find when id drift started. early suspect: commit e7b1a (compact-vocab pack reorder). if confirmed we'll revert on canary. also prototyping embedding-padding heuristics to keep offsets stable.
ops: staging canary rollback prepared for zenon-q4-int8, will hold until triage. incident I-2026-95 created.
mei: opening tokenizer preproc PR (draft): https://git.internal/tokenizer/pr/4901 — adds ZWSP-aware cluster join and unit tests (mixed CJK+Arabic+ZWSP). local smoke -> BLEU -0.58.
dmitri: bisect result: suspect commit e7b1a reproduces locally; p-value 0.0018; bisect artifact: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/zenon/q4/bisect/e7b1a (internal)
ravi: ok assigning: dmitri (bisect + embedding padding patch), mei (preproc PR + locale-suite tests), ops (hold rollback until patch validated). i'll collect failing samples for the ticket.
dmitri: will add a runtime histogram check for sentence-level token-id drift vs fp16 (KL threshold 0.02) and a nightly alert.
mei: will add regression test to locale-suite that runs on every candidate int8 build.
ops: rolled canary back to fp16 baseline; monitoring.
ravi: thanks everyone. ping here when tests land. :white_check_mark:
summary: zenon-q4 int8 onboarding uncovered ZWSP-caused token splits between CJK and Arabic; short-term: ZWSP-aware preproc join and canary rollback; long-term: embedding pack alignment, bisect shows commit e7b1a suspect, add token-id histogram detector and locale-suite tests
